name: PMO Strategic Plan Register
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Plan:Link/PMO Strategic Plan:220",
    plan_name AS "Plan Name:Data:220",
    period_from AS "Period From:Date:110",
    period_to AS "Period To:Date:110",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Strategic Plan`
ORDER BY period_from DESC, plan_name
